what: Deck boards, joists and screws for a rectangular deck
title: Deck Calculator: How Many Deck Boards Do I Need? | Calcupine
description: Calculate deck boards, joists and screws for a rectangular deck. Works with any board width, gap and length. Free with a printable shopping list.
lede: Enter your deck size and board details. Get the number of deck boards, joists at your spacing, and screws. The example is a 16 by 12 foot deck with 16 foot boards.

faq.q: How many deck boards do I need for a 12x16 deck?
faq.a: With 5.5 inch boards and 1/8 inch gaps, 12 feet of width needs 26 rows. Running 16 foot boards along the 16 foot side, that is 26 boards, or 29 with 10% extra.

faq.q: How far apart should deck joists be?
faq.a: 16 inches on center is standard for wood decking laid straight. Diagonal decking and many composite boards need 12 inches. Always check the board maker's instructions.

faq.q: How many screws do I need for a deck?
faq.a: Two screws per board at every joist. A 16 by 12 deck with 13 joists and 26 rows needs about 676 screws.

faq.q: What gap should I leave between deck boards?
faq.a: About 1/8 inch for dry or composite boards. Wet pressure-treated boards shrink, so they are often laid tight. Follow the product's guide.
